text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day during training, Eishin Flash

unexpectedly stops in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff! For some reason, my legs feel heavier than usual.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Finishing within the allotted time will be

impossible at my current pace...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to push myself harder to keep
on track
with the schedule...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She must be fatigued from all the races
she's been
running. Looks like I need to
rethink her race
schedule.
